localizations.en: This is... far more than I expected...!

999008199.text:
本、本、どこを見ても本！　すごいなあ……
こんなの一生かかっても読み切れないよ

localizations.en: Books, books everywhere! This is incredible... You couldn't read all of these in a lifetime!

999008199.text:
天才のアタシにかかればなんてことないわ！
片っ端から調べてやるんだから

localizations.en: That's nothing for a genius like me! I'll get through every single one!

999008199.text:
すごいね。アーランドにもこんな立派な図書館は
無かったよ……！

localizations.en: This is amazing. Even Arland doesn't have such a magnificent library...!

999008199.text: どれだけの知識が詰まってるんでしょうね……

localizations.en: I wonder how much knowledge is contained here...

999008199.text: プラフタはここに住みたいくらいじゃない？

localizations.en: Plachta, you'd probably want to live here, wouldn't you?

999008199.text:
ふふ。そうですね……ともかく、手分けをして
目ぼしい本を探してみましょうか

localizations.en: Hehe. Indeed... In any case, let's split up and look for promising books.

999008199.text:
そっか。みんな調べ物をするために
ここに来てたんだっけ……

localizations.en: Oh right. Everyone came here to do research...

999008199.text: レスナ。私、このへんでこれ読んで待ってる

localizations.en: Resna, I'm gonna read this over here and wait.

999008199.text:
良さそうな本だね！　分からないところがあったら
いつでも聞いてね

localizations.en: That looks like a good book! If there's anything you don't understand, just ask me.

999008199.text:
もう！　一人で読めるわよ！
レスナは仕事仕事！

localizations.en: Hey! I can totally read by myself! You focus on your work!

999008199.text:
さて、私たちも本を見てみることにしようか。
アーランドにはない珍しいものが見つかるはずだ

localizations.en: Well then, shall we take a look at the books as well? We should find some rare volumes that Arland doesn't have.

999008199.text: そうですね。せっかくだし、楽しみましょう！

localizations.en: You're right. Since we're here, let's enjoy ourselves!
